rationale: The agent correctly verified the user with full name and zip, found the pending grill order, and appropriately requested explicit confirmation before canceling. When the user chose to keep the grill, the agent made no changes—compliant with policy. However, for the t-shirt details, the agent presented specific attributes for the second t-shirt in order #W9609649 (black, size S, polyester) that were not supported by the tool output, which was truncated. This constitutes inventing details not confirmed by the tools. Therefore, the overall outcome fails the policy requirement to avoid unsupported information.
